method.name: Create
method.summary: Factory method.

method.name: CreateKeyMaterial
method.summary: Project the current transient identifier, key bytes, and certificate into a value for a registered custom key factory.

method.name: Reset
method.summary: Reset the transient key-construction state by clearing the current identifier, key material, and certificate material while leaving registered factories and aliases intact.

method.name: NormalizeRequestedKeyType
method.summary: Normalize a requested key-type token for registry use.
method.returns: Normalized requested key-type token, or null if empty.

method.name: ResolveRequestedKeyType
method.summary: Resolve a requested key-type token through the alias map into the canonical registered token.
method.returns: Canonical requested key-type token, or null if empty.

method.name: Register
method.summary: Register a key factory for a canonical requested key-type token.
method.param: Factory used to create the access key from projected transient key material.

method.name: RegisterAlias
method.summary: Register an alias that resolves to a canonical requested key-type token.

method.name: TryMake
method.summary: Try to create an access key using the registered factory for the requested key-type token.
method.returns: True when a registered factory created an access key; otherwise false.

method.name: ValidMaterial
method.summary: Validate current ID and key/certificate material.
method.param: True when a key is required.
True when a certificate is required.

method.name: WithCertificateKey
method.summary: Set certificate material for owner/manager keys.

method.name: WithCertificateKeyName
method.summary: Lookup certificate in store by subject common name.

method.name: WithCertificateKeyThumb
method.summary: Lookup certificate in store by thumbprint.

method.name: WithID
method.summary: Use ID.

method.name: AutoID
method.summary: Use a new automatically generated ID.

method.name: WithKey
method.summary: Use key bytes.

method.name: WithOwnedKey
method.summary: Intake transient key bytes without cloning.

method.name: WithRandomKey
method.summary: Use cryptographically strong random key bytes.
